comparison.objective: Dry-fit and peg a mortise-and-tenon frame corner, versus finish HELICOIL inserts by breaking their tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Large joinery insertion and peg seating rather than recessed coaxial mandrel placement, notch fracture, and metal-fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: A dry-fitted, pegged frame corner; detailed seating and damage thresholds are absent. Candidate requires four fractures without coil or shell displacement.
comparison.reason: Any shared striking or insertion primitive serves a different tested ability: structural joint assembly rather than controlled sacrificial-tab fracture and containment.
